name: popover

frames.best_why: The panel is open with a typed note and the X and Submit controls both visible.

tagline: A small button swells into a note panel you can type in.
summary: A Leave a note button that morphs into a large rounded form with a placeholder, a textarea, and close and submit buttons in its footer.
appearance: A compact dark Leave a note pill sits on black. Clicked, it grows into a wide rounded dark panel with faint grey placeholder text top-left, a small X at the bottom-left and a bordered Submit button at the bottom-right.
behaviour: The button expands into the panel with a light spring; typing hides the placeholder, and the X, an outside click or Escape closes it and clears the note while the panel shrinks back.
demo_content: Button reading Leave a note, placeholder Your note, and the typed line Invite Sam to the design review.
search_phrases: button that turns into a note form
small text area popup for feedback
use_when: You want a lightweight note or comment form that opens right where the trigger sits.
avoid_when: It is fixed at 364px wide and only suits short notes; long text has no room to grow.
customise: Trigger text, placeholder and footer buttons are composed from exported parts; the fixed 364x200 size and spring live in the source.
weight_why: One panel with a single layout morph; idle while closed.

a11y.note: The textarea has no label or placeholder attribute, and focus is not trapped or returned; the panel has no dialog role.

issues: The textarea has no label or placeholder attribute, so its purpose is only visual.
Focus is neither trapped in the panel nor returned to the trigger.
The panel behaves like a dialog but has no dialog role.
polish_why: Clean morph and clear footer actions; it is a plain note form with basic a11y gaps.
